title: Credit Tier and Contract Payment Record Matrix for Settlement Installments, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Matrix rule.** An installment settlement on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is read against the contract that produced the account, as recorded under Retail Installment Contracts. The settlement contract payments are that contract's posted payments of the installment type, less its returned payments. A contract of the tier Tier 6 Fresh Start or Tier 5 Rebuild with fewer than 24 settlement contract payments cuts 2 installments; a contract of the tier Tier 6 Fresh Start or Tier 5 Rebuild with 24 or more, or a contract of the tier Tier 4 Standard with fewer than 24, cuts 1 installment; every other contract cuts nothing.

## Matrix

| Credit tier of the liquidated contract | Fewer than 24 settlement contract payments | 24 or more |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 2 installments cut | 1 installment cut |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 2 installments cut | 1 installment cut |
| Tier 4 Standard | 1 installment cut | None |
| Tier 3 Advantage | None | None |
| Tier 2 Preferred | None | None |
| Tier 1 Select | None | None |

## How the record is read

- The contract is the liquidated contract recorded on the account; its tier is the one assigned at purchase.
- Posted payments count only when their payment type is installment; every returned payment on the contract is taken off.
- Hypothetically, a Tier 4 Standard contract with 25 installment payments posted and 2 returned has 23 settlement contract payments and cuts 1 installment; with 1 returned it has 24 and cuts none.
